metadata.agent_last_message:
- Implemented the `iges` CLI (no deps) with `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, `roundtrip` in `output/main.js:1` and an executable wrapper in `output/iges:1`.
- Fixed-format IGES parsing + required validations + canonical IGES-JSON emission are in `output/parser.js:1` (S/G/D/P/T, Global delimiter rules, DE/PD parsing, cross-ref checks, required Global numeric `> 0`, spec_version clamping, degenerate Line(110) rejection).
- All 87 entity PD schemas in the prompt are parsed/written via `output/entities.js:1`.
- Deterministic 80-column IGES writer (section sequencing `0000001`…, exact T counts, computed `param_data_ptr`/`param_line_count`) is in `output/writer.js:1`.
- Parametric evaluation for the contract’s curve/surface types (with `xform_matrix` application) is in `output/eval.js:1`.
- Run via `node output/main.js <subcommand> ...` or `output/iges <subcommand> ...`.
